title: A 2 player run ends only when both players are out
why: His answer Q65 (10-18): in 2P the run ends when both players are out. One extraction used to double the score and end the run for both. Now the first player to extract stands out and the run goes on; the second extraction (either order) doubles and ends it.
now: In a 2 player run, one player extracting no longer ends the run for the other.

edits.replacement: ARCADE.deaths=0; ARCADE.holdT=0; ARCADE.xOut=0;   // v23.22 (arcade3); v28.xx (cw-bothout): who has extracted
